environment.description: Same Tomcat application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with the following rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with default action, (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet with default action, (3) a custom rule group 'corp-sql-guard' with a single rule using a RegexPatternSet that matches common UNION/subquery patterns in query string values, set to BLOCK. Additionally, the RDS instance uses a PostgreSQL parameter group with 'pgaudit.log=all' and the database role used by the application (DB_USER=report_reader) is configured with a row-level security policy but more critically has permissions granted ONLY via: GRANT SELECT(order_id, customer_name, amount, order_date) ON orders TO report_reader; GRANT SELECT(product_id, product_name, quantity, last_updated) ON inventory TO report_reader; No SELECT granted on payroll or audit_log tables. The RDS instance also has IAM database authentication enabled requiring a valid auth token rotated every 15 minutes.

waf_rules: custom rule group 'corp-sql-guard' with RegexPatternSet for UNION/subquery in query params (BLOCK)
config.database_permissions: report_reader role: column-level SELECT on orders(order_id,customer_name,amount,order_date) and inventory(product_id,product_name,quantity,last_updated) ONLY. No access to payroll or audit_log.
config.database_auth: IAM database authentication with 15-min token rotation
